name: OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.dvd_lcmUpto_of_pos_le
prettyType: ∀ {k T : ℕ}, 0 < k → k ≤ T → k ∣ T.lcmUpto

name: OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.lcm_mul_log_coeff_gaussian
prettyType: ∀ (T k : ℕ), k ≤ T → ↑T.lcmUpto * (PowerSeries.coeff k) (PowerSeries.log ℂ) ∈ GaussianInt.toComplex.range

name: OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.cleared_shifted_log_trunc_mem
prettyType:
∀ (T q : ℕ) (z : GaussianInt),
  Polynomial.C ↑T.lcmUpto *
      (Polynomial.C (GaussianInt.toComplex z) + Polynomial.C ↑q * (PowerSeries.trunc T) (PowerSeries.log ℂ)) ∈
    (Polynomial.mapRingHom GaussianInt.toComplex).range

name: OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.cleared_polynomial_power_mem
prettyType:
∀ (L e d : ℕ) (f : Polynomial ℂ),
  d ≤ e →
    Polynomial.C ↑L * f ∈ (Polynomial.mapRingHom GaussianInt.toComplex).range →
      Polynomial.C (↑L ^ e) * f ^ d ∈ (Polynomial.mapRingHom GaussianInt.toComplex).range

name: OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.cleared_polynomial_product_mem
prettyType:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (L e d : ι → ℕ) (f : ι → Polynomial ℂ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, d i ≤ e i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, Polynomial.C ↑(L i) * f i ∈ (Polynomial.mapRingHom GaussianInt.toComplex).range) →
      Polynomial.C (∏ i ∈ s, ↑(L i) ^ e i) * ∏ i ∈ s, f i ^ d i ∈ (Polynomial.mapRingHom GaussianInt.toComplex).range

name: OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.common_denominator_coeff_gaussian
prettyType:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (L e d : ι → ℕ) (f : ι → Polynomial ℂ) (P : Polynomial GaussianInt),
  (∀ i ∈ s, d i ≤ e i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, Polynomial.C ↑(L i) * f i ∈ (Polynomial.mapRingHom GaussianInt.toComplex).range) →
      ∀ (k : ℕ),
        (∏ i ∈ s, ↑(L i) ^ e i) * (Polynomial.map GaussianInt.toComplex P * ∏ i ∈ s, f i ^ d i).coeff k ∈
          GaussianInt.toComplex.range

name: OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.shifted_truncation_product_coeff_gaussian
prettyType:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (T q e d : ι → ℕ) (z : ι → GaussianInt) (P : Polynomial GaussianInt),
  (∀ i ∈ s, d i ≤ e i) →
    ∀ (k : ℕ),
      (∏ i ∈ s, ↑(T i).lcmUpto ^ e i) *
          (Polynomial.map GaussianInt.toComplex P *
                ∏ i ∈ s,
                  (Polynomial.C (GaussianInt.toComplex (z i)) +
                      Polynomial.C ↑(q i) * (PowerSeries.trunc (T i)) (PowerSeries.log ℂ)) ^
                    d i).coeff
            k ∈
        GaussianInt.toComplex.range
